brand.idea: I build innovative systems at scale.

values.name: Curiosity
values.means: Innovation: trying the new thing first (ZenMode, the shell, this lab).
values.rule: One confident lead colour nobody near me owns (never PayPal/Google blue).

values.name: Clarity
values.means: Systems that stay simple at 10M+ jobs a day.
values.rule: Quiet neutrals, generous space, one type scale, one accent per screen.

values.name: Ownership
values.means: I ship and measure my own products.
values.rule: One highlighter for 'I built this', and every number in mono as proof.

zenmode._note: ZenMode OS v3 brand (zenmode.figmatokens.json). Used only inside the .zen scope and the ZenMode mark.

palettes.name: Calm
palettes.why: Espresso and ivory: warm, grounded. Sage = calm focus, one orange spark = the builder.

palettes.name: Calm Glow
palettes.why: Calm with the light turned up: brighter ivory, deeper espresso for contrast, a jade-leaning sage with more saturation, same orange spark.

palettes.name: Celestial
palettes.why: Night sky, moonlight and a gold sun. Ink is the night (clarity), violet is the magic (curiosity), gold is the sun and the logo's dot: the proof that it shipped (ownership).

palettes.name: Surya
palettes.why: The sun: saffron and gold, as in Surya and Ram's iconography. Warm, energetic, unmistakably Indian; dawn on a dark sky.

palettes.name: Neelakantha
palettes.why: Shiva: the blue throat, vibhuti ash for the page, the crescent moon in gold, Ganga's blue-teal. Calm, deep, still. (Blue sits near PayPal; teal keeps it apart.)

palettes.name: Peetambar
palettes.why: Vishnu and Krishna: shyam blue-black, peacock teal, lotus pink, and the yellow-gold silk (peetambar). Rich but composed.

palettes.name: Nebula
palettes.why: JWST's Carina Nebula: amber cliffs of gas, blue stellar dust, ionised teal. Science and wonder.

palettes.name: Moonstone
palettes.why: Moon in the night: cool moonstone over midnight, one gold glint. The quietest of the set.

palettes.name: Navaratna
palettes.why: Gems: ruby (Surya's stone in the navaratna) set in gold. Bold and premium, rare among engineers.

palettes.name: Amethyst
palettes.why: Amethyst and gold: the gem version of Celestial, softer and more jewel-like.

palettes.name: Signal
palettes.why: Ink black + paper white do 90% of the work (clarity). One electric violet for every action (curiosity). Highlighter yellow marks proof, like a pen on a printout (ownership).

palettes.name: Ember
palettes.why: Your approved orange as the lead: energy and shipping. Warm off-white and near-black keep it grown-up; yellow marks the proof.

palettes.name: Tide
palettes.why: Deep teal: calm depth and systems that flow. Distinct from ZenMode green and PayPal blue.

palettes.name: Bold
palettes.why: Spicy orange leads: energy, momentum, shipping. Powder blue cools it down.

palettes.name: Indigo Spark
palettes.why: Earlier pick (softer Signal). Violet = curiosity, silver = clarity (engineered, like brushed metal), a sun-yellow spark = ownership. Indigo-black base stays clear of PayPal navy.

typography.name: Builder
typography.why: Hand-made character: an engineer who builds and ships real products. Bold Bricolage headings over calm Manrope body text give the hierarchy its contrast; Instrument Serif italic is the accent voice for one word per heading; Space Mono carries the numbers. Vendored in public/fonts.

typography.name: Zen
typography.why: Current set (shared with ZenMode). Geometric display, neutral body, pixel mono.

typography.name: Grotesk
typography.why: Engineer's voice: quirky grotesk headings, IBM's systems heritage in body + code.

typography.name: Editorial
typography.why: Leader's voice: a serif headline reads like writing and judgement, not just code.

typography.name: Swiss
typography.why: Precise and neutral, Big-Tech-native. Safest, least distinctive.

typography.name: Syne
typography.why: Wide, art-directed headings: design-led engineer. Most unusual.
